newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end sharply lower as banks tumble.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end sharply lower as banks tumble.

text.p: - The UK's FTSE 100 index of leading shares chalked up its biggest one day decline in point terms for two months on Monday as bank stocks tumbled and fears grew of a possible rise in UK interest rates later this week.
Worries over the Labour government's first budget, confirmed for July 2, also helped send the index 58.5 points lower at 4,562.8 -- its biggest fall since a 65-point loss on April 1.

With Wall Street unsettled by fresh fears of a rise in interest rates, the FTSE 100 was in near free-fall at one stage late in the session, setting the scene for what analysts and traders said could be a jittery month.
